title: Kula Today
heading: Today
summary: No cloud over Kula yet. First clouds will form at about 3,400 ft, a little higher if the slope warms first. Kula Ag's dew point is up 4 °F since 04:05 and it is still 90% humid. Today's forecast: Thermals probably flat. Trades from the ENE should put the shear line at Pukalani. Upslope has not set in yet.
